summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares targeted post-surgery radiation therapy (I²-PORT) followed by standard chemotherapy or immunotherapy with standard chemotherapy or immunotherapy alone. It is for non-small cell lung cancer that still has cancer in the lymph nodes after surgery. I²-PORT is given once a day, Monday through Friday, for 15 to 25 treatments over 5 to 6 weeks, and standard treatment starts 1 to 42 days after radiation ends and continues unless the disease gets worse or side effects are unacceptable. The main outcome is not stated; the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara la radioterapia dirigida después de la cirugía (I²-PORT) seguida de quimioterapia o inmunoterapia estándar, con quimioterapia o inmunoterapia estándar sola. Es para el cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas que aún tiene cáncer en los ganglios linfáticos después de la cirugía. La I²-PORT se administra una vez al día, de lunes a viernes, en 15 a 25 sesiones durante 5 a 6 semanas, y el tratamiento estándar comienza entre 1 y 42 días después de terminar la radiación y continúa mientras la enfermedad no empeore ni haya toxicidad inaceptable. No se indica el resultado principal; el estudio figura como fase 2.
who_for: Diagnosis of non-small cell lung cancer, with no small cell component
Lobectomy or larger surgery within 8 weeks, with complete removal and residual cancer in lymph nodes
Prior 2 to 4 cycles of neoadjuvant systemic therapy
No metastatic disease on recent imaging
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or better
not_for: Known EGFR mutation or ALK rearrangement
Prior radiation to the lungs or mediastinum
VEGF inhibitor within 90 days, or planned adjuvant VEGF inhibitor
Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis or interstitial lung disease needing anti-fibrotic medication
Pregnancy, or heart function below New York Heart Association class 2B
